blocks.text: Abbotsford West homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Abbotsford West, September 2026. Detached houses: 138 listed at month end and 12 sold in September, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 210 listed at month end and 16 sold in September, a sales ratio of 8% (a buyers’ market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 55 sold over 4 months against an average of 139.8 listed, about 10.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 20 sold. Condos and townhomes: 86 sold over 4 months against an average of 215.0 listed, about 10.0 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 26 sold.

faq.q: How did Abbotsford West sell in September 2026?
faq.a: Detached recorded 138 active listings, 12 solds and a 9% sales ratio — the city's second-largest detached shelf, with the ratio joint with Abbotsford East — and Condos & Townhomes recorded 210 listings, 16 solds and an 8% ratio, second in the city behind Central Abbotsford on both counts; medians are published at community level only (Abbotsford detached $949,000; attached $497,500) (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools serve an address in Abbotsford West?
faq.a: Catchment is set by address in the SD34 School Locator. Recorded runs for three west-side addresses show the area splits: 3614 Clearbrook Road returns Clearbrook Elementary → Colleen and Gordie Howe Middle → W.J. Mouat Secondary; 2990 Oriole Crescent returns John MacLure Community School → Colleen and Gordie Howe Middle → W.J. Mouat Secondary; and 3433 Firhill Drive returns Blue Jay Elementary → Eugene Reimer Middle → Rick Hansen Secondary (SD34 School Locator, mybaragar.com, run 2026-11-01). Run any specific address before relying on a school.

faq.q: How does transit connect Abbotsford West to the rest of the region?
faq.a: BC Transit routes 1 and 2 run from Highstreet, route 66 Fraser Valley Express runs from Highstreet toward Lougheed Station, route 21 runs the Fraser Highway corridor beside the southwest edge, and the Highstreet Transit Exchange on Highstreet Access Road has six bus bays for local and regional routes (see ~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/batch-1/abbotsford-west-guide.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: Is land on the rural west edge in the Agricultural Land Reserve?
faq.a: Parts of the rural west and southwest are in the ALR; in the A1 zone the minimum subdivision lot area is 8.0 ha and in A2 it is 16.0 ha, and an added residence in the ALR must also meet the ALC limits — principal residence 500 m² or less, suite only inside it, additional residence 90 m² or less (40 ha or less) or 186 m² or less (over 40 ha) — as well as City zoning.
